verdict: 113 independent checks pass; no remaining blocker in the scoped app integration. Actual packaged-app Vision/UI smoke not executed by this reviewer.

coordinator: All selected heading and navigation passes finish before reference collection; earlier source pages receive templates from later selected pages.
Absolute sparse page indices, staff arrays, metadata replacement, reference provenance and phase-specific render calls retained.
Variable layouts skip recognition with visible reason; no cadence override or forced counts.
Render and OCR module errors preserve successful independent modules and valid staff acceptance; failed navigation prevents inline symbol from becoming its own destination.
No reference templates means a visible unsupported/reference issue rather than zero-match success.
Cancellation during each of headings/navigation/references/destinations discards partial new metadata.
documentWorker: Real synthetic five-page PDF rendered and staff analysis run through PartsmithDocument worker, with only OCR coordinator injected.
Opt-out calls zero injected runners and retains valid plan; sparse page selection stays absolute.
Recognition runs off main; completion on main. Failure adds issue without project mutation or acceptance barrier.
Each of four phases blocked deterministically, canceled, and replaced by a new run; no stale completion/progress/issues reach new run.
Changing source data or rectification while worker runs rejects stale review.
reviewEdits: Remove selected source-copy only; main crop and unrelated page stay exact.
Removal persists across unrelated crop edit, reset, replan, override serialization, apply, project serialization and undo/redo.
Invalid removal indices do not mutate review.
Page invalidation removes raw automatic metadata/copies and exposes optional issue without blocking complete valid assignments.
No-op replan and crop-only changes retain direction ownership.
Part swaps, profile reorder and complete system reorder clear stale automatic copies without shrinking explicit reviewed crop edges.
Distinct manual rectangles added after scan remain; entire authoritative lists supplied before initial review are treated as explicit reviewed choices.
Same rectangle can be manually chosen for one recipient and automatically copied for another; invalidation distinguishes them even after recipient swaps.

limits: Injected deterministic coordinator tests do not establish native Vision availability in the packaged app.

Explicit lists present before initialization are authoritative manual/reviewed choices, even if some entries originally came from an older auto run; there is no persisted per-item provenance in this implementation.
Synchronous Vision/image operations are cooperatively canceled at phase/request boundaries, not necessarily mid-request.
Endings remain a separate scratch native pilot; this app option does not promise full repeat, rehearsal-letter or bar-number coverage.
Tests exercise source-mark project geometry/placement persistence and undo, not a new full-source note-by-note musical audit.
